scope: Actual documentation routes and controls: 22 defaults, 86 selectors, data/code, mock success/failure/cancellation, 22 family routes, 22 batch-lab routes, gallery groups and narrow layouts. Public domain workflows have separate reports.

checks.name: All 22 catalog detail routes start with visible business records, actual role context and guided examples
All 86 named configurations can be selected in the actual detail page with matching data and role
Example data and usage code show the selected full dataset, including custom records instead of empty props
Catalog example operations receive local acknowledgements and reset restores the chosen fixture
Student data and usage tabs omit unreleased answers and drafts belonging to other roles
Changing a detail route cancels the old example request without modifying the new example
Three gallery groups contain all 22 populated examples and attached business controllers
All 22 family preview routes use populated examples, data summaries and configurable variants
Family business operations preserve failed modal input and succeed on a second acknowledgement
All 22 batch-lab routes explain their actual dataset and expose the loaded JSON
Default, data and code detail layouts stay inside a 390px viewport
